title: Complete Dactyl issues #52 and #54-#57
intent: Complete the remaining Dactyl #52/#54-#57 contract and cross-adapter proof gaps after merged PR #58, preserving pure-Rust lightweight local storage, caller-owned schema/retry policy, trait-based Neon parity, and no SQLite C/rusqlite/subprocess/Turso.
stop_conditions: No SQLite C, libsqlite3-sys, rusqlite, SQLite subprocess, or Turso runtime dependency
No retry, idempotency, migration/version policy, or domain semantics in Dactyl
No false-green conformance skips; unavailable remote proof must be explicit
unresolved_contradictions: The current Dactyl Neon mock uses /query and /batch while Propodus v1 documents resource and /api/v1/store/transactions routes; do not silently claim full live Propodus parity or invent a domain translation layer in this wave.
deferred_questions: Propodus resource-route translation and live deployment proof remain downstream work in Propodus #54/#55/#57; Dactyl mock conformance must remain network-free and explicit about transport capability.

phases.name: Research current contract gaps
phases.description: Inspect merged Dactyl code, tests, README, and issue acceptance to choose the smallest next proof wave.

phases.name: Implement bounded contract and adapter parity
phases.description: Add only the missing low-level Rust primitives and deterministic local/Neon conformance needed by #52 and #54-#57.

phases.name: Run proof and governance validation
phases.description: Run focused tests, full checks, dependency audit, Decapod validation, and inspect the final diff.

phases.name: Publish and update issues
phases.description: Commit with SSH signing, publish the PR through Decapod, and update remaining issue threads with evidence.
